risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Unforeseen global economic uncertainties, including geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions, can impact real estate markets; economic slowdowns or recessions can lead to decreased demand and lower property values.
- Real estate contracts frequently include contingencies (deliverables, inspection etc.) that can entitle contractors to time extensions; inadequate contractual provisions could lead to business losses from unforeseeable events.
- It is critical to recruit and retain qualified workers amid growing competition; experienced employees may be poached as new competitors take an aggressive stance in the industry.
- Revenue and profit recognition are closely linked to project execution milestones and handovers, causing natural timing swings between years — the prior year's revenue reflected completion/handover of major projects while the year under review was a transition phase with fewer projects reaching revenue recognition.
- Fluctuations in construction material prices, financing costs, and global economic uncertainties continue to pose challenges to the real estate sector the Company operates in.
- The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act (RERA) requires the Company to promptly handle and resolve customer complaints, fostering an open and accountable climate for homebuyers.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Actively seeking opportunities in the Panvel region with the goal of developing large-scale townships.
- Exploring strategic joint ventures in the Pune market to support growth trajectory.
- Exploring options that promote sustainable growth, focusing on long-term value creation and resilience to maintain stability in the real estate market.
- Continuing to strengthen the development pipeline with strategically located projects, further expanding footprint in the Panvel region.
- Focus on execution excellence and prudent financial management across the project pipeline.
